illegal.elisa:19: warning: local `step` stays visible after its last use [-Wnever-leak]
  declared on line 19, last used on line 21; still visible across 2 later statements (line 22 to line 23, starting with `sink(total)`)
  kind: chain (its last use binds another local, so that binding can take the statements as a block expression)
  fix: nest it in a block expression that ends with its last use:
          total: i64 = |count|
              step: i64 = seed * 3
              count <- count + 1
              step + count
          sink(total)
  (the `|...|` header lets the block write the outer bindings it updates; list any it mutates through a call too)
illegal.elisa:34: warning: local `first` stays visible after its last use [-Wnever-leak]
  declared on line 34, last used on line 36; still visible across 1 later statement (line 37, starting with `sink(second)`)
  kind: overlap (a local declared after it is still needed after its last use)
  no nesting works as written: `second`, declared on line 35 inside that range, is still used on line 37, so a block ending on line 36 would hide it too
  fix (reorder): move the declaration of `second` below the last use, if its initializer has no effect the moved statements depend on, then nest:
          region first_scope:
              first: i64 = seed + 1
              sink(first)
          second: i64 = seed + 2
